identification: Oak serving tray (about 53 x 36 cm) with moulded rim, hand painted with a realistic seated thylacine seen from behind. Lot title attributes it to Alison Cooper-White; no signature visible in the single photo and the back is not shown. I could not find any artist of that name linked to thylacine art on the web, so the attribution is unverified. Closest known name is a Tasmanian 'Alison Cooper' who painted a table centre at Gowans.

viewing_check: Look at and photograph the back and edges of the tray and the painting for a signature, initials, label or date (Cooper-White or similar). Check whether the thylacine is painted directly on the oak or on an applied panel, and the quality of the paint work. Check the price sticker on the front.
